headlines.text: Flash back to 2024, when Serena Deeb vs. Mariah May closed out Dynamite, rated 6.56 with the women's division on full display.

Rewind to 2024, when Chris Jericho vs. Katsuyori Shibata fought tooth and nail for the FTW Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.66. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Adam Copeland vs. Buddy Matthews clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.64. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2024, Claudio Castagnoli vs. Brian Cage crossed paths for the first time ever on Dynamite, rated 6.35.
